info.name: 22 - Session Exercises
info.description: Endpoints to batch-create and batch-delete exercises within a workout session.

request.description:
Batch-creates multiple session exercises in a single request.

### Request Body

An array of `SessionExerciseCDTO` objects:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sessionId` | `int` | Yes | Parent session ID |
| `exerciseId` | `int?` | No | Linked exercise ID (nullable for custom exercises) |
| `exerciseName` | `string` | Yes | Max 200 characters |
| `sets` | `int?` | No | Number of sets |
| `reps` | `int?` | No | Repetitions per set |
| `weightKg` | `decimal?` | No | Weight in kilograms |
| `restSeconds` | `int?` | No | Rest period in seconds |
| `notes` | `string?` | No | Max 300 characters |
| `orderIndex` | `int` | Yes | Display order (0-based) |

Returns `201 Created` with `Result<IEnumerable<SessionExerciseRDTO>>`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

body.raw:
[
  {
    "sessionId": {{lastSessionId}},
    "exerciseId": null,
    "exerciseName": "Incline Dumbbell Press",
    "sets": 3,
    "reps": 12,
    "weightKg": 20.0,
    "restSeconds": 90,
    "notes": "Control the negative",
    "orderIndex": 0
  },
  {
    "sessionId": {{lastSessionId}},
    "exerciseId": null,
    "exerciseName": "Lateral Raises",
    "sets": 3,
    "reps": 15,
    "weightKg": 10.0,
    "restSeconds": 60,
    "notes": null,
    "orderIndex": 1
  }
]

request.description:
Batch-deletes multiple session exercises by their IDs.

### Request Body

An array of integer IDs to delete:

```json
[1, 2, 3]
```

Returns `Result<string>` with message "Session exercises deleted successfully."

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.
